dog.description_text: Meet Cilly — New Arrival! Cilly just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FCilly%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQoOIkK17yDhRJTnJ2bdzoSoEgUCYsApO1iOjzijQtrDA%2D2%2DYw Her foster says "her personality has really blossomed. She is a super curious cat and loves pets and chin scratches especially. She likes to follow me around and ask for pets, especially when I'm making food (haha) but also spends lots of time looking out the window or exploring my apartment. Her favorite spot is where she has a good view of everything. I love her curiosity! I find it very cute when she follows me around and watches what I'm doing :) ". "She has become a very affectionate and trusting cat. She likes to be around me whenever I'm in my apartment and will usually sit in my lap when I'm on the couch or curl up with me in bed. She's fairly calm during the day, and likes to relax in confined spaces (I often find her sitting under the couch) but does become more playful in the the evening, this is usually when she likes to play with toys or explore my apartment. She likes high surfaces so that she can observe what's happening around her, and sometimes sits in the window too. She absolutely loves to be pet around the face and ears. She is super cuddly". She has been spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
